title: Fixed-coin affine isolation into measured 3-CNF batches
claims: Measured batches of 3-CNF have no satisfiable query on negative inputs and have an exactly-one-model query on at least one eighth of prescribed tapes for positive inputs.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.
